content.mcp.badArgs.defaultMessage: "args" must be a list of strings.
content.mcp.badArgs.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "args" field (keep it as it is) isn't a list of text.

content.mcp.badCommand.defaultMessage: "command" must be the program to run.
content.mcp.badCommand.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "command" field (keep it as it is) is empty or not text.

content.mcp.badCwd.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "cwd" field (keep it as it is) isn't text.

content.mcp.badName.defaultMessage: Server names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters). "hive" is reserved.
content.mcp.badName.description: An error adding an MCP server: its name has a character a server name can't have, is too long, or is hive (Hive's own server: keep it).

content.mcp.badRecord.defaultMessage: "{field}" must be an object of strings.
content.mcp.badRecord.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's {field} field (env or headers, as it is) isn't a set of names with text values.

content.mcp.badUrl.defaultMessage: "url" must be an http:// or https:// address.
content.mcp.badUrl.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "url" field (keep it as it is) isn't a web address.

content.mcp.changed.defaultMessage: {name} has changed since it was shown to you. Check what it runs and enable it again.
content.mcp.changed.description: An error turning an MCP server on: its definition ({name} is the server) changed after Hive showed what it runs, so it stays off until checked again.

content.mcp.chooseFile.defaultMessage: Choose a .json definition or a .zip of a server folder.
content.mcp.chooseFile.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file that is neither a .json definition nor a .zip.

content.mcp.connects.description: What an MCP server connects to, shown before it is turned on: {url} is its address.

content.mcp.connectsType.description: What an MCP server connects to, shown before it is turned on: {url} is its address, {type} its transport (http or sse, as the definition says it).

content.mcp.env.description: An MCP server's environment variables, shown before it is turned on: {items} lists them, each NAME=${VAR} (a reference, as it is) or "NAME (set)".

content.mcp.exists.description: An error making a new MCP server: the workspace has one called {name}.

content.mcp.folder.description: The folder an MCP server runs in, shown before it is turned on.

content.mcp.headers.description: An MCP server's HTTP headers, shown before it is turned on: {items} lists them, each Name=${VAR} (a reference, as it is) or "Name (set)".

content.mcp.jsonLarge.defaultMessage: The .json is too large for an MCP server definition (over {mb} MB).
content.mcp.jsonLarge.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .json file over {mb} MB.

content.mcp.listNoCommand.description: Why an MCP server in the workspace can't be used: its definition has neither of the two fields that say what it is. Keep "command", "url", stdio, http and sse as they are.

content.mcp.listNotObject.defaultMessage: Definition must be a JSON object
content.mcp.listNotObject.description: Why an MCP server in the workspace can't be used: its definition file (.hive/mcp/<name>.json) holds JSON that isn't an object.

content.mcp.noCommand.defaultMessage: The definition needs a "command" (a server Hive starts) or a "url" (an http or sse server).
content.mcp.noCommand.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file whose definition has neither field that says what it is. Keep "command", "url", http and sse as they are.

content.mcp.notJson.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition {file} can't be read as JSON. {reason} is the JSON reader's own words (English).

content.mcp.notObject.defaultMessage: The definition must be a JSON object, as in {path}.
content.mcp.notObject.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file whose definition holds JSON that isn't an object. {path} is where a workspace keeps one (.hive/mcp/<name>.json).

content.mcp.runs.description: What an MCP server runs, shown before it is turned on: {command} is its command line, as it is.

content.mcp.set.description: An environment variable or header ({name}) an MCP server's definition gives a value of its own, not shown (it may be a secret).

content.mcp.taken.defaultMessage: A server named "{name}" already exists: choose another name, or replace it.
content.mcp.taken.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file under the name {name}, which a server of the workspace has.

content.mcp.zipFileLarge.defaultMessage: The .zip is too large for an MCP server (over {mb} MB).
content.mcp.zipFileLarge.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip file over {mb} MB.

content.mcp.zipLarge.defaultMessage: The .zip is too large for an MCP server (over {mb} MB unpacked).
content.mcp.zipLarge.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip: its files take more than {mb} MB unpacked.

content.mcp.zipLink.defaultMessage: The .zip has a link, which Hive doesn't unpack: {path}
content.mcp.zipLink.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip with a symbolic link in it ({path}), which could point outside its folder.

content.mcp.zipNoDefinition.defaultMessage: No {files} found. A server .zip has its definition at its top level, or inside one folder.
content.mcp.zipNoDefinition.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip without a definition where Hive looks. {files} are the file names it looks for, joined with "or".

content.mcp.zipTooMany.defaultMessage: The .zip has too many files for an MCP server (over {max, number}).
content.mcp.zipTooMany.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip with more than {max} files.

content.mcp.zipUnreadable.defaultMessage: The .zip can't be read: it has no list of its files.
content.mcp.zipUnreadable.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip that isn't one (no central directory: the list of its files).

content.mcp.zipUnsafe.defaultMessage: The .zip has a file with an unsafe path: {path}
content.mcp.zipUnsafe.description: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip: a file's path ({path}) would land outside its folder, or Windows can't have it.

content.mode.noAssistant.defaultMessage: The Assistant has no settings in this workspace.
content.mode.noAssistant.description: An error switching the Hive Assistant's mode: the workspace's Assistant settings are missing.

content.mode.unknown.defaultMessage: There is no mode "{mode}" in this workspace.
content.mode.unknown.description: An error switching the Hive Assistant's mode: the workspace has no mode (a persona file) called {mode}.

content.notes.badName.description: An error renaming a shared note: the new name is empty or has a character Windows can't have in a name (such as / or :).

content.notes.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
content.notes.closed.description: An error: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while a handover was being renamed; nothing changed.

content.notes.deleteRoot.defaultMessage: Cannot delete the shared folder itself
content.notes.deleteRoot.description: An error: the shared notes folder itself (.hive/shared) can't be deleted, only what is in it.

content.notes.exists.description: An error making or renaming a shared note or folder: one called {name} is already there.

content.notes.handoverCreated.description: A notice's title: an agent saved a handover in the shared notes; the project and the handover's title follow.

content.notes.nameRequired.description: An error making a shared note or folder with no name.

content.notes.openHandover.description: The notice's button: opens the handover an agent just saved.

content.notes.outside.defaultMessage: Path is outside the shared notes folder
content.notes.outside.description: An error: a shared note's path leads out of the workspace's shared notes folder (.hive/shared).

content.persona.badName.defaultMessage: Give the mode a name with letters or numbers.
content.persona.badName.description: An error making a new mode for the Hive Assistant: its name has no letters or numbers to name its file after.

content.persona.exists.defaultMessage: There is already a mode called "{mode}".
content.persona.exists.description: An error making a new mode for the Hive Assistant: the workspace already has one called {mode}.

content.persona.invalid.description: An error deleting a mode of the Hive Assistant: its id isn't one Hive could have made.

content.persona.notBundled.description: An error restoring a mode Hive ships: Hive ships no mode called {mode}.

content.skill.audience.defaultMessage: {kind, select, text {its audience is "{audience}", not agents, assistant or all} empty {its audience is empty, not agents, assistant or all} list {its audience is a list, not agents, assistant or all} other {its audience is a {type}, not agents, assistant or all}}
content.skill.audience.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its header's metadata.audience isn't agents, assistant or all (keep those three words, which the header must say). {kind} is what it is instead: text ({audience} is the text), empty, a list, or another YAML value ({type}: number, boolean or object, as YAML names them). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.badName.defaultMessage: Skill names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters).
content.skill.badName.description: An error adding a skill: its name has a character a skill's name can't have, or is too long.

content.skill.cantCopyName.defaultMessage: "{name}" can't be a Hive skill name: use letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (rename the folder first).
content.skill.cantCopyName.description: An error copying a skill into the workspace: its folder's name {name} can't be a Hive skill's name.

content.skill.cantDelete.defaultMessage: Only Hive skills and a project's local skills can be deleted in Hive.
content.skill.cantDelete.description: An error deleting a skill Hive doesn't manage (a CLI's own, from the user's profile or a plugin).

content.skill.chooseFile.description: An error adding a skill from a file that is neither Markdown (.md) nor a .zip.

content.skill.copyExists.defaultMessage: The workspace already has a skill named "{name}"
content.skill.copyExists.description: An error copying a skill into the workspace: it has one called {name} already.

content.skill.exists.defaultMessage: A skill named "{name}" already exists in {folder}
content.skill.exists.description: An error adding a skill: the skills folder {folder} (relative to the workspace) already has one called {name}.

content.skill.isCopy.defaultMessage: That's Hive's own copy of a workspace skill; delete the skill in the workspace instead.
content.skill.isCopy.description: An error deleting a skill in a project's folder that is Hive's copy of a workspace skill (Hive puts it there for a coding agent).

content.skill.metadata.defaultMessage: its metadata isn't a set of fields (metadata:, then audience: … indented under it)
content.skill.metadata.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: the metadata field of its SKILL.md header isn't a set of fields. Keep metadata: and audience: as they are. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.noLocalFolder.description: An error adding a project's own skill for a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Codex") that reads no skills from a project's folder.

content.skill.noTarget.defaultMessage: No place to add the skill to.
content.skill.noTarget.description: An error adding a skill with no place chosen for it (the workspace, or a project for a coding agent).

content.skill.notBundled.defaultMessage: "{name}" isn't one of Hive's bundled skills.
content.skill.notBundled.description: An error restoring a skill Hive ships: Hive ships no skill called {name}.

content.skill.notClosed.defaultMessage: its header isn't closed (no line with --- after it)
content.skill.notClosed.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its SKILL.md header (front matter) starts with a --- line but no --- line ends it. Keep ---. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.notClosedWithin.defaultMessage: its header isn't closed within its first {kb} KB
content.skill.notClosedWithin.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its SKILL.md header (front matter, between --- lines) doesn't end within its first {kb} KB. It follows "Nobody gets this skill until its header is fixed:", so it starts in lower case.

content.skill.notFields.defaultMessage: its header isn't a list of fields (name: …, description: …)
content.skill.notFields.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its SKILL.md header is YAML but not a set of fields. Keep name: and description: as they are. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.notSkill.description: An error copying a skill into the workspace: its folder has no SKILL.md (a file name: keep it).

content.skill.yaml.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its SKILL.md header can't be read as YAML. {reason} is the YAML reader's own words (English). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.yamlAt.description: Why nobody gets a Hive skill: its SKILL.md header can't be read as YAML. {line} is the line of the file, {reason} the YAML reader's own words (English). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.zipNoSkill.defaultMessage: No SKILL.md found. A skill .zip has SKILL.md at its top level, or inside one folder.
content.skill.zipNoSkill.description: An error adding a skill from a .zip that has no SKILL.md where Hive looks. Keep SKILL.md as it is: it is a file name.

content.skill.zipTooLarge.defaultMessage: The .zip is too large for a skill (over {mb} MB unpacked).
content.skill.zipTooLarge.description: An error adding a skill from a .zip: its files take more than {mb} MB unpacked.

content.skill.zipTooMany.defaultMessage: The .zip has too many files for a skill (over {max}).
content.skill.zipTooMany.description: An error adding a skill from a .zip: it has more than {max} files.

content.skill.zipUnsafe.defaultMessage: The .zip has a file with an unsafe path: {path}
content.skill.zipUnsafe.description: An error adding a skill from a .zip: a file's path ({path}) would land outside the skill's folder.

content.templates.agentGone.defaultMessage: That agent is no longer in the template.
content.templates.agentGone.description: An error adding one agent from a template: the template no longer has it (edited meanwhile).

content.templates.bullet.description: A line of a list of reasons: a bullet, then the reason {item}.

content.templates.cantCheck.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: git couldn't read the state of the one of its name, on {branch}; {error} is why (often git's own words).

content.templates.cantLoad.defaultMessage: The template can't be loaded yet:
content.templates.cantLoad.description: An error loading a template, above the list of what stops it (each line a reason).

content.templates.cantUse.description: An error: the template {name} can't be used; {problem} says why (a sentence).

content.templates.changedSince.defaultMessage: The project's agents changed since you looked: open the template again.
content.templates.changedSince.description: An error loading a template: the project's agents changed after the Load template dialog showed them.

content.templates.changedWhile.defaultMessage: The project's agents changed while the template was loading: nothing was changed. Open the template again.
content.templates.changedWhile.description: An error loading a template: the project's agents changed while it loaded, so nothing changed.

content.templates.checkFailed.description: Why a template can't be loaded: git couldn't tell whether the worktree {folder} of the agent {agent} it would remove has uncommitted work; {error} is why (often git's own words).

content.templates.dirty.defaultMessage: {branch} has {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
content.templates.dirty.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: the one of its name, on {branch}, has work not committed. A clause.

content.templates.editedMeanwhile.defaultMessage: "{name}" changed since you started editing it (saved again meanwhile): nothing was saved. Close the editor to see it as it is now.
content.templates.editedMeanwhile.description: An error saving an edited template: it was saved again elsewhere after the editor opened it.

content.templates.enterName.defaultMessage: Enter a name for the template.
content.templates.enterName.description: An error saving or renaming a template with no name.

content.templates.failed.description: An error loading a template: making its agents failed, so nothing changed; {error} is why (often git's own words).

content.templates.fenced.defaultMessage: A template is being loaded into this project
content.templates.fenced.description: Why an agent can't start (followed by ", so its agents can't start now."): a template is replacing the project's agents. A sentence without its full stop.

content.templates.gitBroken.defaultMessage: {problem}, so its worktree {count, plural, one {agent} other {agents}} ({names}) can't have worktrees of their own: fix git (Agent Setup), or edit the template to put them in the project folder.
content.templates.gitBroken.description: Why a template can't be loaded: git can't run ({problem}: "Git isn't installed (or isn't on Hive's PATH)"), so its {count} agents with worktrees of their own ({names}) can't have them. Agent Setup is a Help window.

content.templates.gone.defaultMessage: That template is no longer there.
content.templates.gone.description: An error: the template was deleted or renamed meanwhile.

content.templates.importNotJson.defaultMessage: It isn't a Hive agent template (not JSON).
content.templates.importNotJson.description: An error importing a template: the file isn't JSON.

content.templates.importTooLarge.defaultMessage: It isn't a Hive agent template (over {kb} KB).
content.templates.importTooLarge.description: An error importing a template: the file is larger than {kb} KB, more than any template.

content.templates.inUse.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: another agent works in the one of its name, on {branch}. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.inUseNow.defaultMessage: an agent works in it now
content.templates.inUseNow.description: Why a worktree the user chose to remove with a template's load was kept: one of the new agents works in it. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.loading.defaultMessage: A template is already being loaded into this project.
content.templates.loading.description: An error loading a template while another load into the same project is under way.

content.templates.nameEach.defaultMessage: Enter a name for each of its agents.
content.templates.nameEach.description: An error loading a template: a name given for one of its agents is empty.

content.templates.nameEachTooLong.defaultMessage: A name is at most {max} characters for each of its agents.
content.templates.nameEachTooLong.description: An error loading a template: a name given for one of its agents is longer than {max} characters.

content.templates.nameTaken.defaultMessage: There is already a template called "{name}" there.
content.templates.nameTaken.description: An error renaming or editing a template: another template where it is kept (the workspace or a project) is called {name}.

content.templates.nameTooLong.defaultMessage: A template's name is at most {max} characters.
content.templates.nameTooLong.description: An error saving or renaming a template whose name is longer than {max} characters.

content.templates.namesChanged.defaultMessage: The names given for its agents no longer match the template: open it again.
content.templates.namesChanged.description: An error loading a template: the names chosen for its agents in the Load template dialog no longer fit it (it was edited meanwhile).

content.templates.neededBy.defaultMessage: {problem, select, unknown {This Hive doesn't know the coding agent "{provider}" (update Hive), needed by {agents}.} off {{provider} is turned off (Settings → Providers), needed by {agents}.} other {{provider} isn't installed (Agent Setup), needed by {agents}.}}
content.templates.neededBy.description: Why a template can't be loaded: a coding agent CLI its agents {agents} (their names, listed in the language's way: "Builder and Reviewer") need. {problem} and {provider} as in the reason without the agents.

content.templates.needsIt.defaultMessage: {problem, select, unknown {This Hive doesn't know the coding agent "{provider}" (update Hive): {agent} needs it.} off {{provider} is turned off (Settings → Providers): {agent} needs it.} other {{provider} isn't installed (Agent Setup): {agent} needs it.}}
content.templates.needsIt.description: An error adding one agent from a template: the coding agent CLI it needs. {agent} is its name; {problem} and {provider} as in the reason a template can't be loaded.

content.templates.noAgents.defaultMessage: This project has no agents to save.
content.templates.noAgents.description: An error saving a project's agents as a template: it has none.

content.templates.noBranch.defaultMessage: its worktree is on no branch, not {branch}
content.templates.noBranch.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: the one of its name has no branch checked out (a detached HEAD), not its own {branch}. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.noFile.description: An error importing a template: the file chosen is gone.

content.templates.noWorkspace.description: An error: the workspace's templates need a workspace open.

content.templates.notChecked.description: Why a worktree the template's load would leave can't be removed with it: Hive couldn't check it. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.notListed.defaultMessage: git doesn't list {folder} as a worktree any more
content.templates.notListed.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree, not the one of its name: git no longer lists that folder as a worktree. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.notOnBranch.defaultMessage: {project} isn't on a branch (a detached HEAD, or no commit yet), so its worktree {count, plural, one {agent} other {agents}} ({names}) have nothing to branch from. Check out a branch or make a first commit, or edit the template to put them in the project folder.
content.templates.notOnBranch.description: Why a template can't be loaded into the project {project}: it has no branch checked out, so the template's {count} agents with worktrees of their own ({names}) have no branch to start theirs from.

content.templates.notRepo.defaultMessage: {project} isn't a git repository, so its worktree {count, plural, one {agent} other {agents}} ({names}) can't have worktrees of their own. Make it a repository with a first commit, or edit the template to put them in the project folder.
content.templates.notRepo.description: Why a template can't be loaded into the project {project}: it isn't a git repository, so the template's {count} agents with worktrees of their own ({names}) can't have them.

content.templates.nothing.description: An error loading a template, nothing changed: {problem} is why, a sentence of its own (how many agents a project can have).

content.templates.otherBranch.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: the one of its name has another branch checked out ({current}) than its own ({branch}). A clause, lower case.

content.templates.provider.defaultMessage: {problem, select, unknown {This Hive doesn't know the coding agent "{provider}" (update Hive)} off {{provider} is turned off (Settings → Providers)} other {{provider} isn't installed (Agent Setup)}}
content.templates.provider.description: Why a template can't be loaded: a coding agent CLI it needs. {problem} is why: unknown ({provider} is the id the template gives, which this version of Hive doesn't know), off (turned off in Settings → Providers), or not installed (Agent Setup is a Help window). {provider} is otherwise its name ("Codex").

content.templates.removing.defaultMessage: A worktree it would work in again is being removed, or was just removed: nothing was changed. Open the template again.
content.templates.removing.description: An error loading a template: a worktree one of its agents would work in again was removed while it loaded, so nothing changed.

content.templates.running.defaultMessage: {agent} is running or starting: stop it first.
content.templates.running.description: Why a template can't be loaded: the agent {agent} it would replace is running.

content.templates.scope.description: An error: where a template is kept must be workspace or project (keep those two words: they are the values to use).

content.templates.several.defaultMessage: several clean worktrees could be its ({branches})
content.templates.several.description: Why a template's agent gets a new worktree: more than one unused worktree made for its name could be its own ({branches}: their branches, listed in the language's way), so Hive takes none. A clause, lower case.

content.templates.started.defaultMessage: An agent started meanwhile: nothing was changed. Stop it first.
content.templates.started.description: An error loading a template: one of the project's agents started while it loaded, so nothing changed.

content.templates.taken.defaultMessage: {names} {count, plural, one {is already an agent} other {are already agents}} in {projects}: agent names are unique across the workspace, so rename {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
content.templates.taken.description: Why a template can't be loaded: agents of other projects ({projects}) have its agents' names {names} ({count} of them). {names} and {projects} are lists, in the language's way ("B1 and R1").

content.templates.takenNothing.defaultMessage: {names} {count, plural, one {is already an agent} other {are already agents}} in {projects}: agent names are unique across the workspace, so rename {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Nothing was changed.
content.templates.takenNothing.description: An error loading a template: agents of other projects ({projects}) took its agents' names {names} ({count} of them) while it loaded, so nothing changed. {names} and {projects} are lists, in the language's way ("B1 and R1").

content.templates.twice.defaultMessage: Two of its agents would be called "{name}".
content.templates.twice.description: An error loading a template: the names given for its agents call two of them {name}.

content.templates.uncommitted.defaultMessage: {agent} has uncommitted work in its worktree ({folder}): commit or discard it first.
content.templates.uncommitted.description: Why a template can't be loaded: the worktree {folder} of the agent {agent} it would replace has work not committed.

content.templates.unreadable.description: Why a template can't be used: its file couldn't be read.
